title: The four-body super-eight and the rotating-square obstruction
exact_target: Prove existence of the equal-mass four-body super-eight orbit.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002532 (AIM-PHYSICS-0040). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 3.

status_qualification: The primary workshop remarks already mention a computer-assisted interval-arithmetic proof. The source’s historical question is retained, with no fresh proof audit or open-status conclusion. A rotating square in the same symmetry class is an obstruction to a naive minimizing argument, not the super-eight itself. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase. The inherited catalogue status is solved; this historical statement is retained without independently verifying that settlement.
